campaign.title: Rename BOUNDED_SCORE to NORMALIZED_SCORE, preserving identity, bindings and behavior.

initial.code:
FUNCTION BOUNDED_SCORE(X)
  BOUNDED_SCORE = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    BOUNDED_SCORE = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 100) THEN
    BOUNDED_SCORE = 100
  END IF
  BOUNDED_SCORE = BOUNDED_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
  IS_PASSING = 0
  IF (BOUNDED_SCORE(X) >= 60) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  END IF
  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_EXCELLENT(X)
  IS_EXCELLENT = 0
  IF (BOUNDED_SCORE(X) >= 90) THEN
    IS_EXCELLENT = 1
  END IF
  IS_EXCELLENT = IS_EXCELLENT
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION HIGH_PRIORITY(X)
  HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
  IF (IS_EXCELLENT(X) >= 1) THEN
    HIGH_PRIORITY = 1
  END IF
  HIGH_PRIORITY = HIGH_PRIORITY
END FUNCTION
